property_summary: For any caller who locked a guess and then calls settle after the target block, the reference contract only pays out 2 ether when the stored guess equals the blockhash (and thus never increases contract balance loss for matching guesses), whereas the mutant pays out when the stored guess differs from the blockhash — so the invariant is: after settle, address(c).balance is decreased by 2 ether iff the stored guess equaled the blockhash (reference); the mutant instead decreases balance when they differed.
change_summary: Change the comparison to check guesses[msg.sender].guess != answer instead of equality, so transfer occurs for non-matching guesses, altering post-settle state and balances.
